The concept of distilling 2D diffusion priors into 3D representations was introduced by [DreamFusion](12087-dreamfusion.md).

Subsequent works adapted this principle for specific domains: [DreamAvatar](12490-dreamavatar.md) for humans, [Single-Stage Diffusion NeRF Training](12803-single-stage-diffusion-nerf-training.md) for joint optimization, [ReconFusion](13211-reconfusion.md) for few-view reconstruction, and [Nerfbusters](13427-nerfbusters.md) for artifact removal.
